notes: Section-level provenance for an empty extraction, not a compound record. Lines 1055 to 1078 of the rebuilt document were read in full and the section genuinely names no chemical substance. It is EPO apparatus rather than applicant disclosure, and the EPO disclaims it at line 1058 as no part of the European patent document. The content is two citation tables: the patent documents EP 1314724 A1 against paragraph [0003] and WO 0021924 A against [0004] and [0020] to [0021], and one non-patent citation, J. BERNSTEIN ; R.J. DAVEY ; J.O. HENCK. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 1999, vol. 38, 3440-3461, against [0003]. Publication numbers, author names, a journal title, a volume and page range are all document identifiers. The compounds those documents concern are named in the description itself, at the paragraphs this table points to, and are extracted there rather than here. The section ends at line 1078, the final data row of the non-patent-literature table, which is the last line of the document; the file has no trailing newline, so wc -l reports 1077. Line numbers were remapped from the pre-rebuild document via /tmp/ep2045/linemap.json; no record content changed.
